stage0036_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Apparently there was a room like this
　at A Baoa Qu, the old Principality's
　last stronghold...」

stage0036_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Palau's governor is an ardent sympathizer
　of the old Principality of Zeon.
　One should accept kindness graciously, taste aside」

stage0036_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I consider that one mark of a leader too」

stage0036_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I suppose the Supreme Commander's much the same...」

stage0036_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「He's the same. He recognizes
　his own position, and strives
　to fulfill that role.」

stage0036_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Well done.
　Captain, Lt. $$マリーダ$$, you may withdraw」

stage0036_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「What's wrong?
　Have a seat」

stage0036_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「How are you feeling?
　I hear it was quite the ordeal
　getting you out of that Gundam」

stage0036_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Can't share tea with someone you tried
　to kill, $$バナージ・リンクス$$?」

stage0036_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Good reaction.
　But reckless too.
　A pilot's temperament」

stage0036_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Forgive me, but is that mask
　hiding some kind of scar?」

stage0036_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If not, then I'd like you
　to show me your face」

stage0036_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's fine, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.
　$$バナージ$$ is only discussing manners」

stage0036_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Is this to your satisfaction?」

stage0036_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0036_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm told I look just like him.
　I wasn't picked as a body double for nothing」

stage0036_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even so, there are subtle differences.
　This mask is meant to hide them,
　and it's something of a fashion too」

stage0036_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A reminder of $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s existence...
　You could call it propaganda」

stage0036_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No one speaks as frankly as you,
　so I tend to forget.
　Forgive the discourtesy」

stage0036_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Much is still unclear about how you came
　to be entrusted with that mobile suit,
　the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, by the Vist Foundation」

stage0036_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That machine was originally
　meant to come to us,
　as you well know」

stage0036_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Why did $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ choose you
　to bear Laplace's Box...?」

stage0036_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$バナージ$$
（That's what $$オードリー$$ said too...）

stage0036_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「...A slip of the tongue.
　Forget I said that」

stage0036_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...How I got that mobile suit is
　just as I told you before
　I was brought here. Nothing more」

stage0036_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「For us, it's hard to believe
　$$カーディアス・ビスト$$ entrusted it to a stranger」

stage0036_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If so, there must be some reason.
　...Perhaps you're tied to the Vist family too」

stage0036_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Am I obligated to answer...?」

stage0036_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I said stop, $$アンジェロ$$」

stage0036_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...Don't push your luck, brat」

stage0036_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're not obligated.
　But since we want information too,
　we'll consider other means if we must」

stage0036_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What's so significant about Unicorn?
　Does it have something to do with
　this Laplace's Box thing?」

stage0036_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I told you to forget it, $$バナージ$$」

stage0036_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Let me ask you one thing.
　Is Unicorn significant enough
　for Neo Zeon to act over?」

stage0036_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Was that worth committing terrorism,
　worth taking people's lives one-sidedly!?
　No one has the right to that!」

stage0036_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The answer is yes.
　To change the Earth Federation's
　twisted system, and free the Spacenoids」

stage0036_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's precisely why
　Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$ rose up」

stage0036_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You're $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s body double,
　but you're not $$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0036_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The man I saw at Rondenion had
　warmth... the shape of a living
　person. But you...」

stage0036_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You!
　Trying to insult the Colonel!?」

stage0036_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's fine, $$アンジェロ$$.
　$$バナージ$$ seems to see through to the truth」

stage0036_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But you're still young.
　The world's still full of things you don't know」

stage0036_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「For instance, someone close to you...」

stage0036_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's still much for you to learn.
　I want you to understand us...
　I'd welcome you as an ally afterward」

stage0036_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You said I'm not the Supreme Commander」

stage0036_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I define myself as a vessel.
　One to hold the feelings of Spacenoids
　abandoned in space, heirs to Zeon's ideal」

stage0036_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If that's what they want,
　then I'll become $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　This mask exists for that」

stage0036_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll leave $$バナージ$$ to the Captain.
　Let him get to know Palau」

stage0036_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（The shape of a living person, hm...
　Well put, perhaps...）

stage0036_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（But someday, people will come to know...
　the truth behind $$シャア・アズナブル$$...）

stage0036_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0036_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0036_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0036_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0036_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$メラン$$
「...That's the briefing for the Palau raid operation」

stage0036_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The operation's success rests on
　the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. Count on you, Captain $$オットー$$」

stage0036_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Operation starts in four hours.
　Everyone, get ready」

stage0036_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Are you all right, Captain?」

stage0036_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$オットー$$
「There's nothing for it but to do it.
　Anaheim's pushing us too, through
　Mr. $$アルベルト$$, to reclaim their prized new unit」

stage0036_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Recovering Unicorn...
　I have no objection to that」

stage0036_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But we see this as
　a hostage rescue operation」

stage0036_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Because we owe him a debt
　from the fighting after Industrial 7」

stage0036_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$オットー$$
「...True enough.
　Time to repay that kid, it seems」

stage0036_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Are you all right, Captain?」

stage0036_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$オットー$$
「There's nothing for it but to do it.
　Anaheim's pushing us too, through
　Mr. $$アルベルト$$, to reclaim their prized new unit」

stage0036_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Recovering Unicorn...
　I have no objection to that」

stage0036_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But we see this as
　a hostage rescue operation」

stage0036_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Because, knowing you, Mr. $$ダグザ$$,
　I figured you'd say getting the Gundam
　back comes first, and $$バナージ$$ second」

stage0036_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「It's fine, $$正太郎$$.
　Prioritizing the mission is only natural」

stage0036_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But what outsiders say doesn't matter.
　We'll rescue $$バナージ・リンクス$$ on our own will」

stage0036_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「You lot probably don't know,
　but this crew owes him a debt」

stage0036_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You mean the battle after
　escaping Industrial 7?」

stage0036_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「That's right.
　It was his do-or-die resolve
　that let us survive」

stage0036_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「This operation is
　a good chance to repay that」

stage0036_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$オットー$$
「I know.
　My feelings are no different from the Lt. Colonel's」

stage0036_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's all right, $$オードリー$$.
　We'll save $$バナージ$$ ourselves, no matter what」

stage0036_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Is it possible... something else is worrying you?」

stage0036_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Because lately... ever since we
　reached space, you've seemed down, $$オードリー$$」

stage0036_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$n
「If it's hard to tell us,
　you could talk to Miss $$スズネ$$ instead」

stage0036_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$スズネ$$
「If you don't mind, would you tell me?
　I'd like you free of regrets before we launch」

stage0036_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$オードリー$$
「...We're going to attack Palau, aren't we...」

stage0036_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Because that place is a Neo Zeon base now」

stage0036_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$オードリー$$
「But it was originally a resource satellite.
　Many people unrelated to the military live there too」

stage0036_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No need to worry, $$オードリー$$.
　Our goal is, above all, to rescue $$バナージ$$」

stage0036_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't attack the residential district,
　nor do more damage to the facility than necessary」

stage0036_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I understand it as an ideal,
　but isn't it difficult in reality?」

stage0036_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll do it anyway.
　I won't justify war as a means」

stage0036_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll show $$シャア$$ that too」

stage0036_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$赤木$$
「I agree with Captain $$アムロ$$.
　Palau's an important home
　for the people who live there」

stage0036_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カレン$$
「We'll only be hitting Neo Zeon.
　I promise, $$オードリー$$」

stage0036_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$リディ$$
「So just wait for us, at ease」

stage0036_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's how it is.
　Will you trust us?」

stage0036_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ジン$$
「I mean it's inefficient.
　If we attack the residential district, the enemy's
　forces would scatter to defend it...」

stage0036_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ジン$$
「If the residents panic,
　our operation's success rate goes up too」

stage0036_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Then watch $c fight.
　We'll show you we can rescue $$バナージ$$
　without doing things that way」

stage0036_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$...
　You're against me too, huh」

stage0036_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's not it, $$ジン$$.
　I want you to understand too... our fight」

stage0036_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Because you're one of us too...
　a member of $c」

stage0036_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$バナージ$$'s the same...
　that's why everyone's trying so hard」

stage0036_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Please pray the operation succeeds too, $$ジン$$」

stage0036_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Sorry about that.
　You came all this way for dinner at our place,
　and my son had to go and get involved」

stage0036_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$バナージ$$
「It's true this is a Neo Zeon base,
　and that I'm cooperating with the Federation forces...」

stage0036_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Well, yeah.
　But it's the Federation and Zeon at war,
　not you and me」

stage0036_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「So, well... don't let it bother you too much」

stage0036_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'll take it from here.
　$$ギルボア$$, go on home」

stage0036_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「I'll do that.
　It's been a while since I was home, so the kids
　are probably dying for attention」

stage0036_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「What you said at dinner,
　about there being no such thing as a just war...」

stage0036_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...I'm not taking it back.
　No matter how much Zeon claims it frees Spacenoids,
　war still kills people with nothing to do with it...」

stage0036_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Zeon says the war is the Federation's fault,
　but that's wrong... it's not right!」

stage0036_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「...What you're saying isn't wrong」

stage0036_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「There's no such thing as a just war...
　But being right doesn't always save people」

stage0036_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「...The early space settlers were mostly people
　down on their luck on Earth, political prisoners,
　or those with no other way to survive」

stage0036_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「When $$宇宙世紀$$ began under $$ＵＣＷ$$,
　the premier called it a split from the age of gods...」

stage0036_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「But those forced to live in the dark of space
　needed a light to cling to」

stage0036_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Without light, people can't go on living.
　But those abandoned in space
　eventually found a light to replace the gods」

stage0036_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「A new light, called Zeon...」

stage0036_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「They needed it.
　To resist despair and keep living
　in a cruel, unfree world...」

stage0036_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「People can live fine without such things,
　clinging to something with no substance is foolish...」

stage0036_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「If anyone can say that for certain...
　they're either extremely fortunate,
　or disconnected from the world」

stage0036_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Only humans possess gods...
　someone told me once, a power that
　transcends the now, an inner god named possibility...」

stage0036_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「A romantic, huh...
　Words like that don't come without believing
　in people and the world. Must've been a kind soul」

stage0036_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I've talked too much...
　must be because it's been a while off duty」

stage0036_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Um... could you tell me your name?」

stage0036_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you pilot mobile suits too,
　$$マリーダ$$?」

stage0036_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$バナージ$$
「N-no... that person seemed drunk...
　and just bumped into me out of nowhere...」

stage0036_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$バナージ$$
（I was handed a note...?
　What... is this...）

stage0036_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Recovering me alone doesn't end the operation...
　We can't stay here, not me... not you either...」

stage0036_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$!」

stage0036_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Is the $c attack outside
　to take back you and the Unicorn...!」

stage0036_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Let me go, $$マリーダ$$!
　If I can just get this Unicorn back,
　$c will leave this place!」

stage0036_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's just an excuse!
　As if I'd leave Palau, a Neo Zeon
　stronghold, unguarded!」

stage0036_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Just focus on ending this fight now!
　At this rate, the people living in Palau,
　even $$ギルボア$$'s family, could get caught up in it!」

stage0036_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's your excuse!
　While keeping the Princess prisoner...」

stage0036_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$!!」

stage0036_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$シャア$$
「Good work, $$ナナイ$$.
　I'll hear your report on $$クェス$$ at length later」

stage0036_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「That girl's talent is genuine.
　Emotionally she's a bit unstable,
　but she'll be an asset in battle」

stage0036_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Bothered by Newtypes being used as tools of war...?」

stage0036_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$シャア$$
「I suppose that makes me soft too」

stage0036_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ and $$クェス$$ have also arrived at $$アクシズ$$.
　After some minor adjustments, I plan to send
　them both to Commander $$ハマーン$$」

stage0036_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ wants to make a name for himself.
　$$ハマーン$$ should know how to use him well」

stage0036_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「As for $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　what do you plan to do?」

stage0036_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I believe I understand what you mean, $$ナナイ$$.
　But for now, let him do as he likes」

stage0036_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「In today's battle,
　he reportedly used members of the $$マーティアル$$
　cult he hired on his own authority」

stage0036_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$シャア$$
「The god of war from $$アストラギウス$$, huh...
　I hear it teaches that people evolve
　through battle」

stage0036_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$シャア$$
「For those who use Newtypes as tools of war,
　it may well be a fitting god...」

stage0036_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$シャア$$
「But we are Spacenoids.
　By believing in the infinite future we carve
　for ourselves, we broke from the idea of gods」

stage0036_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$シャア$$
「One could say the inner god named possibility
　has slain the old gods」

stage0036_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「And now, Colonel, you seek to overthrow
　the Earth Federation and bury the old order」

stage0036_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$シャア$$
「...As for $$フロンタル$$, let him do as he likes.
　Plenty of people believe in that man, after all」

stage0036_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$シャア$$
「Besides, trying to get Laplace's Box
　means dealing with $c in the end」

stage0036_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$シャア$$
「Though... I'd hate for $c
　to go down too easily, either...」

stage0036_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Do you know what's inside the box, Colonel?」

stage0036_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$シャア$$
「I don't know the details.
　The only one in the world who knew, most likely,
　was the late $$カーディアス・ビスト$$」

stage0036_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Laplace's Box, a thing that could upend the world...
　$$フロンタル$$ is obsessed with that legend」

stage0036_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$シャア$$
「And hidden within it lies another truth...」

stage0036_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$シャア$$
「While investigating the truth behind my father
　Zeon Zum Deikun's death, I stumbled onto the Earth
　Federation's first prime minister's assassination」

stage0036_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「Besides both being an unexplained death
　of a leader, is there a link between them...?」

stage0036_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$シャア$$
「To solve that, we'd need Laplace's Box.
　Trace either assassination's background,
　and you run into those very words.」

stage0036_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「The Federation and Zeon leaders' murders...
　Laplace's Box...」

stage0036_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$シャア$$
「But the world can be changed without
　relying on such conspiracies.
　For now, I'll leave the front to $$フロンタル$$.」

stage0036_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シャア$$
「A private friend of mine will arrive soon.
　Sorry, but $$ナナイ$$, please leave us.」

stage0036_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シャア$$
（Laplace's Box...
　I doubt that information capable of shifting
　the world's balance in an instant truly exists）

stage0036_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シャア$$
（No... that's not something I should say
　right now...）

stage0036_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$シャア$$
（At the very least, its existence surely
　held some meaning in humanity's history...）

stage0036_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Should I say it's been a while, Captain $$クワトロ$$?」

stage0036_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$シャア$$
「Right now, I go by $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　That's what you should call me.」

stage0036_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$五飛$$
「Then answer this, $$シャア$$.
　Can you change this twisted world?」

stage0036_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$シャア$$
「At the very least, I bear this name
　with that resolve.」

stage0036_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$五飛$$
「...Very well.
　I'll trust that look in your eyes.」

stage0036_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$シャア$$
「There's a reason I called you here.
　I have a favor to ask, will you hear me out?」

stage0036_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$スザク$$
「If you're asking us to join Neo Zeon,
　we refuse.」

stage0036_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it.
　There's something I want you to look into.」

stage0036_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$シャア$$
「You've heard from $$スメラギ・李・ノリエガ$$, it seems...」

stage0036_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$シャア$$
「As you guessed, $$ゼロ$$.
　I want you to pursue UG, and beyond it,
　whoever stands behind it.」

stage0036_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　Though even I have only a vague idea of it.」

stage0036_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I made it back, $$オードリー$$.」

stage0036_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I owe you and everyone at $c
　my gratitude.」

stage0036_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you for not letting Palau
　burn in the flames of war...」

stage0036_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Could the Princess Ms. $$マリーダ$$ mentioned...
　really be $$オードリー$$ after all...）

stage0036_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$バナージ$$
（And that Laplace's Box $$フル・フロンタル$$
　mentioned... what could it possibly be...）

stage0036_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$シン$$
「You...!
　Making us worry like that!」

stage0036_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Mr. $$カミーユ$$, Mr. $$シン$$!
　And everyone else too...!」

stage0036_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$甲児$$
「If something happened to you, I couldn't face $$沙慈$$.」

stage0036_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$カトル$$
「But Ms. $$ミコット$$ was just as happy as
　Ms. $$オードリー$$ that $$バナージ$$ was safe.」

stage0036_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$カレン$$
「Come on, $$ミコット$$!
　Let's just enjoy this moment!」

stage0036_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm glad, $$バナージ$$.
　That we could meet again like this.」

stage0036_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$宗介$$
「A soldier's greatest duty is to return alive.
　You have fulfilled it.」

stage0036_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$n
「Sorry, $$バナージ$$.
　That's just $$宗介$$'s own way of welcoming you.」

stage0036_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Well done yourself, Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$.」

stage0036_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「We did manage to recover the Unicorn,
　but we can't afford to be careless.」

stage0036_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Yeah... the enemy's weak resistance was
　odd too. Or did Neo Zeon achieve its goal
　just by capturing the Unicorn?」

stage0036_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$バナージ$$, the only one who can start
　the Unicorn, hasn't done anything. So I doubt it...」

stage0036_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll need to stay on guard, then.」

stage0036_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「True enough...
　Still, no harm in savoring joy a while.」

stage0036_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ジン$$
（What is this feeling...
　Seeing everyone laugh and celebrate
　makes something stir in me too...）

stage0036_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's because, $$ジン$$...
　you're a part of $c too.」

stage0036_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You don't need to say it, $$ジン$$.
　I was the same way once.」

stage0036_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Now I can laugh together with everyone too.
　Because I'm... one of us.」

stage0036_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$カイエン$$
（This wrongness that's crept in around me
　these past few days is giving me nightmares...）

stage0036_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$カイエン$$
（Akbarjin Badbayar...
　if he's behind this, then what is he...）

stage0036_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since Master $$バナージ$$ escaped Palau so
　swiftly, the residents' joy became Z-Chips.」

stage0036_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I see...
　So joy becomes Z-Chips too.」

stage0036_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That comes to 100Z...!
　I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0036_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The war between Zeon and the Federation
　can't be stopped, and the Unicorn only feeds it...）

stage0036_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$バナージ$$
（What should I... do...
　Is it right for me to keep piloting
　the Unicorn like this...）

stage0036_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, Master $$ダグザ$$.
　It's been a while since I've seen Echoes' strength.」

stage0036_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, not at all!
　You just hadn't had much chance to shine lately...」

stage0036_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Let me be clear, as ground-combat personnel we
　guide civilian evacuations alongside
　$$２１世紀警備保障$$, and handle recon and scouting.」

stage0036_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Fighting from inside a machine isn't
　the only kind of battle for $c.
　And you, a robot, of all things...!」

stage0036_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Stop it, $$コンロイ$$.
　Don't let him get to you.」

stage0036_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「We're short-handed too.
　The $$ロト$$ loaded at Londenion is assembled,
　so I'll go out in a mobile suit myself.」

stage0036_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I'm leaving command of Echoes to you from now on.」

stage0036_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you're ground-combat personnel, why not
　just fight in a normal suit instead...」

stage0036_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no!
　I'm just doing my duty as a dimensional trader!」

stage0036_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's get fired up... business, business!」
